worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.summary: Fire a main electric beam first, then branch conduction from the struck target toward nearby enemies. The beam advances along the aim line over up to 4 ticks, and the first real obstruction (body or block) sets its endpoint; in spread mode it grows a tree of short chains from the main victim, each target hit once. A hit may paralyse the target. Electric types are immune to paralysis.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.descriptio: The main beam advances along the aim line out to %1$s blocks and stops at the first real obstruction; a hit deals about %2$s special Electric damage at %3$s blocks per tick (the advance finishes in at most 4 ticks); a wall or empty air only sparks at the endpoint.

The impact spans %1$s blocks, and a target that actually takes damage has a %2$s%% chance to be paralyzed for %3$s. Paralysis halves movement speed and gives each attempted action a 25%% chance to fail; Electric types are immune, and the status can be cleansed.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.spread.on: Spread mode: after the main beam really hits an enemy, every 3 ticks it grows a short chain from a struck node to the nearest un-hit, visible enemy no further than the burst radius, reaching up to %2$s more targets (each takes %1$s of the direct hit as damage only, with no separate paralysis roll); the burst is wider, the beam slower, adding 2 wind-up and lengthening the cooldown, while the direct hit is x0.82. A wall or a miss grows no chain.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.spread.off: Focused: the main beam strikes only its target, x1.06 direct damage and a faster advance, with no branching.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.growth.1: From level %1$s the paralysis chance rises to %2$s and the burst reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.use.1: Tag a crowd and share the discharge with its neighbours
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.use.2: Open from a distance before closing
worldcombat.skill.thunderbolt.preference: On: after the main beam hits, it grows a tree of short chains from the victim to connected enemies (each takes a fraction of the power); widens the burst x1.5, adds 2 windup and cooldown x1.15, but the direct hit is x0.82. Off: a focused hit at x1.06 that advances faster, with no branching.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of firing; larger values open from further away.

When on, a target ranks higher by how many enemies it can really chain to (edge within chain range, line of sight clear), so spread mode favours the target that reaches more; when off, it ranks as an ordinary ranged attack.
When on, targets not yet paralysed rank a little higher, so the small paralysis chance is not spent on someone already pinned; when off, all threats rank the same.
